db/prepared#

Prepared statements: SQL parsed once, run many times with new values.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let add = await db.prepared("INSERT INTO notes(title, body) VALUES (?, ?)");
await add.execution(DbText("groceries"), DbText("tea, milk"));
await add.execution(DbText("ideas"), DbNull());
add.close();
